contentPattern.structure: one row, two or more cells: text (heading, copy, CTA links/buttons) beside a photo, illustration or icon; options change the split (pair, bleed, strip, no-panel, overlay)
contentPattern.rows: usually 1; extra rows repeat the layout

usage: Split promotional banner: text and CTA beside one photo or graphic. Background colour comes from section metadata Style (forest, green, bright-green, eggshell, neon, white, black).
reuseGuidance: Use for text + image split banners and CTA strips. pair = two equal icon/photo + link columns; bleed = image fills its half edge to edge; deadline = text overlaid on the illustration in the same cell; no-panel = bare row of icons; no-panel-image-background = image cell becomes the row background with text over it; strip = slim one-row CTA strip; dark-3/dark-4 = equal-width cells (dark-4 puts the last cell on a dark panel).
